ambient: They show you another thing, quickly, before there is no time.
Something is decided about you and everyone is pleased.
The pace picks up. They are trying to fit it all in.
description: There are things here and they are delighted. Not menacing. Delighted, and busy, and in the middle of showing you something enormous at a speed you cannot follow. They know you. You have the strong sense that you knew them, before, and agreed to this.
name: The Ones Who Were Expecting You

looks: Delighted. Genuinely. It is almost embarrassing.
They have too many parts and all of them are being used well.
One of them checks you are keeping up and carries on regardless.
objects.name: the ones here

looks: Enormous, obvious, and going past far too fast.
You understand it perfectly and will not be permitted to keep it.
It is about you, mostly, and you are not the important part.
objects.name: what they are showing you

weather: It is warm here, and the warmth is coming from the activity rather than from anywhere.
